officialAccount.bio: The official PlayFinder account. Questions or ideas? Use Send feedback in the menu.

starters.content: Padel players: where do you play? Drop your favourite courts below, and say if you're after a game this week.
Badminton people, where are you playing at the moment? Share your hall, and your level if you're looking for a partner.
Five-a-side or eleven-a-side? Tell us where you play and whether your team needs players.
Tennis players: which courts are you using this month, and are they worth it?
Where's the best run right now? Indoor or outdoor, tell us below.
Runners: what's your go-to route? Share it below, and say if you'd like company.
Gym crowd: where are you training, and what are you working on at the moment?

padel.content: Tried padel for the first time last night. Way harder than it looks, I spent half the game hitting the glass. Hooked though.

comments.content: the glass is the whole game once you get used to it

padel.content: Thinking about getting into padel this winter. Do I need my own racket or can you hire one at most places?

comments.content: I hired one, cost a couple of quid. Try it before you buy

padel.content: Anyone else find weeknight padel courts get booked up really quickly? Is it worth booking a week ahead?
